text: {"assertions":["A signature mismatch bug in crypto/keys/rotation.py was caused by a race condition in lazy initialization.","The bug manifested as a verification failure against the previous key after the client retried.","The fix uses a double-checked lock to guard the lazy initialization.","The fix was submitted as PR #1806 on the fix/signature-mismatch-1 branch.","The bug reproduces when rotating the signing key while requests are in flight.","After the fix, the flaky test failure rate dropped from 6 per 100 runs to zero."]}
